Organised/unorganised coverage not stated on this page; note the same publisher's all-ayurvedic page puts organised at 70% / unorganised at 30% in 2025, and the ayurvedic personal-care tail (loose oils, regional herbal brands) is heavily unorganised.

growth.source: Honasa Consumer Ltd (Mamaearth) -- Q4 and FY26 Investor Presentation, dated 2026-05-21, BSE regulatory filing
growth.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: company-level, consolidated across Honasas full brand portfolio (Mamaearth, The Derma Co, Aqualogica, Dr. Sheths, BBlunt, Staze, Reginald Men), not a category-wide clean/vegan market figure -- no market-wide series exists. Filed under emerging_adjacencies/clean_vegan because Mamaearth (clean, toxin-free, Made Safe-certified positioning) is Honasas flagship and largest brand and anchors the portfolios identity, though some house brands (The Derma Co, Aqualogica) are actives/dermatology-positioned rather than clean-vegan specifically. Company-stated headline: Honasa delivered 20% YoY growth in FY26 (Apr25-Mar26); Revenue from Operations INR 2,479 Cr vs INR 2,067 Cr in FY25 (internally consistent, implies 19.9%). Covers organised-market listed-company sales (ecommerce + general/modern trade) only; no unorganised-market read implied or available.

cagr.notes: IMARC: India ayurvedic skincare USD 2.0bn (2025) to USD 5.8bn (2034), CAGR 11.98% 2026-2034. SCOPE CAVEAT: ayurvedic skincare only, not the full ayurvedic/herbal BPC adjacency. cf the same publisher's all-ayurvedic-products CAGR of 15.52% — but that basket is 58% healthcare (medicines and nutraceuticals), which is outside BPC, so the two are not comparable and must not be averaged. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated.

shares.qualifier: Shares of summed revenue for 3 listed BRAND OWNERS (INR inr_cr, NET_REALISATION). Does NOT include unorganised/unlisted players. Conglomerate members (HUL/Godrej/LG H&H) carry non-BPC revenue, so their shares overstate BPC position. Excluded as different value-chain levels (not brand shares): Nykaa (FSN E-Commerce) (retailer).

bottom_up.qualifier: Sum of latest reported revenue for 3 listed players (INR inr_cr), NET_REALISATION basis. Coverage excludes unorganised/unlisted competitors. NOT a market size: Godrej Consumer Products, Hindustan Unilever report revenue well beyond BPC (conglomerate/total-company figures). Excluded as different value-chain levels (not brand owners): Nykaa (FSN E-Commerce) (retailer).

mismatches: Unit/currency differ (top-down USD usd_bn vs bottom-up INR inr_cr) - convert before comparing.
Value basis differs (top-down RETAIL vs bottom-up NET_REALISATION). India RETAIL vs NET_REALISATION differ by the MRP trade margin (lib/transforms/mrp_normalise.py).
Bottom-up base is inflated by non-pure-play conglomerates (Godrej Consumer Products, Hindustan Unilever) reporting non-BPC revenue.
reconciliation.note: Numeric gap not computed: bases are not directly comparable (see mismatches). Bottom-up here is a coverage indicator, not a market-size cross-check.

headline.trade_base: ~US$50m (H1 2025 basis), +44.7% YoY — small base, fast growth
headline.entry_barrier: CDSCO import registration (Form COS-1 -> COS-2 via SUGAM portal) — pre-clearance before any consignment; key friction and lead-time cost
headline.momentum: K-beauty is accelerating its India entry to offset SWANA-region volatility (Personal Care Insights, Apr 2026). 2026 launches: APR's Medicube (Nykaa + Tira), AmorePacific's Illiyoon (Nykaa exclusive), TirTir (Nykaa, Jun 2026), Tira's Hince (Jan) and Dr. Melaxin (Jul). India K-beauty ~INR 3,139cr (2025) forecast ~26% CAGR to ~INR 32,424cr by 2035 (Expert Market Research). AmorePacific is scaling India via platforms/imports, NOT local manufacturing — no India plant announced.
